name: same-arch-stopped-continuation-primitive-contract
purpose: Define the first narrow machinen move live-state continuation primitive before implementation. This is a same-architecture stopped single-thread safe-point contract, not a reexec or reconstruction route.

mayPromoteOnlyAfter: happy-path target resumes from captured live state
no target-native reexec/restart/resource reconstruction path is used
every refusal class fails closed with no target process left running
focused tests and proof rows pass with retained evidence
productStatus.scopeLimit: same-architecture only; not cross-architecture product support

process.safePoint: user-mode instruction boundary outside active syscall
process.lifecycle: source process is frozen before capture and stays frozen until target continuation decision
refuseWhen: active syscall or syscall restart state
process is already exiting or in signal delivery
missing executable path or bytes identity
program counter outside a verified executable mapping

resources.stdio: only closed, /dev/null, or explicitly move-owned inert stdio is accepted in the first primitive
resources.signals: no pending signal, no active signal frame, no non-default handler state, no alternate signal stack
resources.sessions: no controlling terminal, PTY, job-control, process-group, or interactive session state
refuseWhen: any socket, pipe, eventfd, epoll, timerfd, inotify, signalfd, device, lock, or mmap-backed kernel resource is observed
any pending/caught/blocked signal state is outside the modeled empty/default shape
any PTY, terminal, session, or process-group state is required

steps: create a target continuation container/process under move control without running the source argv as a fresh program
verify target executable/text mapping identity matches the captured source text mapping identity
materialize captured private writable mappings and stack bytes at compatible target addresses or a proven relocated address plan
install captured same-architecture registers and thread-local state
validate no refused resource class appeared during target preflight
resume execution at the captured instruction pointer
report targetPid only after the resumed thread reaches the continuation success marker
successEvidenceMustShow: resumed state depends on captured register or memory values
fresh argv restart would not produce the same success marker
no target-original, target-native-reexec, generic-resource-graph-reexec, static HTTP, file cursor, pipe replay, or resource reconstruction loader was invoked

refusalClasses.reason: source and target architecture must match for this primitive
multiple threads need scheduler, TLS, futex, and inter-thread state models
running or non-owned stops cannot be captured safely
active syscall, restart, or in-kernel wait state is not modeled
target text bytes/build identity must match the captured executable mapping
captured program counter must map to verified target-native text
anonymous/private writable mappings and stack bytes must be captured and materialized
shared, device, vvar, vdso, JIT, or ambiguous mappings need separate models
non-stdio fds are not teleported or reconstructed in this primitive
socket state and active sessions are unmodeled
timer and event-loop state is unmodeled
pending signals, active signal frames, non-default handlers, and alt stacks are unmodeled
PTY, controlling terminal, session, and job-control state are unmodeled
reexec, restart, output replay, descriptor-only equivalence, and resource reconstruction are banned

hardBans: active session migration without an explicit model
product claim without actual continuation proof
nonClaims: not fd/socket/timer/signal continuation outside the exact modeled empty resource shape
not product support until happy-path and refusal proofs are recorded
